BiblicalUsage: Job uses this word for a man who dies in his full strength, wholly at ease and quiet. One dies in his full strength, he says, and another dies in the bitterness of his soul, and both go down to the same dust.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that dying at ease is no sign of God's favour, for Job watched the wicked die quietly too.
